title: Lieutenant output
description: A JSON object corresponding to the LLM's response to a player request. The sequencer will execute all cancels then all orders (each in listed order). Cross-field and reference rules about valid IDs are NOT expressible here and are checked by the parser.

reasoning.description: Short scratchpad, written first so the model resolves references before committing. Logged, never shown to the player.

refusal_reason.description: null when status is ok; required when status is refused.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences shown to the player: what will happen, or why the request was refused.

unhandled.description: Parts of an otherwise-ok request that could not be translated.

command_ids.description: cmd_id values from the ants' queues; non-empty only when scope is 'ids'.

mode.description: replace: drop the subject's current and queued commands first. append: add to the end of its queue.

target.description: An ant or entity id from the input state, a grid cell such as 'N9', or the reserved symbol 'just_built'.

formation.description: Hint to the sequencer for multi-ant movement.

memory_notes.description: Full replacement for the Lieutenant's notes, or null to keep the existing notes.

cell.description: Chess-style grid cell as shown in the GUI: column letter, then row number, e.g. 'N9'.

subjects.description: The ants the order or cancel applies to.
